LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Neiyu_BS1.desc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s origins cannot be verified. By her own account, she is but one of many projections cast into this universe from a higher plane. What is beyond doubt, however, is that she is a true Milira.\n"Eh, you're reading my childhood story? That's supposed to be a secret. Well then, if this is what you want~"\n"Satisfied now? Don't get too greedy, okay?"
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Neiyu_BS1.desc: [PAWN_nameDef] loves to sit somewhere with an open view, staring quietly into the distance. Though she claims that every movement on the planet, even throughout the entire star system, lies within her perception, she still prefers this peaceful way of watching the world unfold.\n"Why are you still reading!! Fine, fine, I don't mind. Hehe."
